source: Single home for model-council seats. Edit this file to swap a model. SKILL.md (both trees) and model-council-console.html read it. Do not copy slugs back into the skill. Chair is always the live session host and is never picked.

picker.note: HTML one-shot picker every run (law A). Count 2-5, then panel, then auditor. Host family greyed. Same-vendor panel refused. Pick file is one-use. All doors OpenRouter. Verdict in chat only.

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.blurb: Anthropic's flagship. Default chair when Claude is the session host (this engine). Pickable as an OpenRouter panel/auditor door when someone else hosts — greyed out of picks while it IS the host.
models.note: OpenRouter id anthropic/claude-opus-5. When this engine is host: door is THIS ENGINE, not a pick. Confirm Opus 5 + max on the live session. The console greys the host family.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.blurb: OpenAI flagship via OpenRouter. Long-horizon analysis, software engineering, and agentic work. Succeeds GPT-5.6 Sol. Row key stays sol so host greying still matches.
models.note: OpenRouter id openai/gpt-6-astra. Effort high. Not Codex in this council — every door is OpenRouter. Intelligence 55 is AA Intelligence Index 54.7, rounded.

models.name: Kimi K3
models.blurb: Moonshot AI's 2.8T-parameter open-weight multimodal reasoner — coding, knowledge work, and long-horizon agentic workflows over large repositories.
models.note: Runs at max (operator-set). OpenRouter id is moonshotai/kimi-k3 — one word, not moonshot/. Intelligence 60 is AA Intelligence Index 59.7, rounded.

models.name: Qwen3.8 Max
models.blurb: Alibaba's Qwen3.8 flagship — multimodal reasoning for coding, visual understanding, and agentic workflows. Moved onto the panel in this roster; it is no longer the auditor.
models.note: Max is the product name. Native reasoning ceiling is xhigh (low / medium / xhigh), not max. Intelligence 58 is a hand estimate — no AA Intelligence Index on the model page at write time.

models.name: Muse Spark 1.3
models.blurb: Meta's agentic reasoner — long-running multi-agent and coding workflows. Configurable reasoning effort; this seat is pinned to xhigh.

models.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.blurb: Google's most intelligent Flash for software engineering, agentic tasks, and multi-step reasoning. Succeeds 3.7 Flash.
models.note: Runs at high. Listed OpenRouter price at write time was the 50% intro discount ($0.375 / $1.875). Intelligence 47 is AA Intelligence Index 47.1, rounded.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
models.blurb: GA release of DeepSeek V4 Pro — large-scale mixture-of-experts. On the bench until seated as panel or auditor.
models.note: OpenRouter id is the dated slug deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813, not the older deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro. Effort max (same ceiling as the previous Pro door). Not a live panel seat.

models.name: GLM 5.3
models.blurb: Z.ai's successor to GLM 5.2 — coding and long-horizon agents. Reasoning is always on. On the bench until seated as panel or auditor.
models.note: Runs at max (provider default; also supports low/high). Reasoning cannot be disabled. Not a live panel seat.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
models.blurb: GA release of DeepSeek V4 Flash — 13B active / 284B total MoE. Cheap, fast, on the bench until seated.
models.note: OpenRouter id is the dated slug deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731. Effort max until you set another. Two DeepSeek rows in the pool is fine; a run should not seat both if vendor diversity is the point. Not a live panel seat.

models.name: Grok 4.6
models.blurb: Catalog auditor label only. This run's auditor is whoever the picker names. Took no part in the debate: a cold read of the chair's synthesis. Pickable as panel or auditor.
models.note: OpenRouter id is x-ai/grok-4.6 — Grok 4.7 is announced, not shipped (no API id as of 2026-09-07). Effort high. Not locked: the picker chooses the auditor from any model with auditor in pickableAs. Default only.
